twin_spore_simmer.name: Twin-Spore Simmer

pilgrims_bone_and_smoke_soup.flavor: Censer-ash threads the broth; the saints come close enough to look in.

sanctified_ghoul_pot.flavor: Sacrilegious and generous; the incense forgives the ghoul its appetites.

river_salted_serpent_pot.name: River-Salted Serpent Pot
river_salted_serpent_pot.flavor: The salt pulls the venom thin; what is left tastes like a slow river at dusk.

tidepool_serpentine_pot.name: Tidepool Serpentine Pot
tidepool_serpentine_pot.flavor: A pot the color of green sea-glass; brine and venom make a frank agreement.

mire_bound_serpent_stew.name: Mire-Bound Serpent Stew
mire_bound_serpent_stew.flavor: Peat-black and bright-eyed; the current goes around you after this one.

bogfrog_hollowpot.name: Bogfrog Hollowpot

venom_pot_of_two_deaths.flavor: Hood and tail hung above the fire; the toxins thin to a nervous warmth.

hound_and_shade_night_stew.flavor: A thin pot, with a long cold aftertaste; sleep does not catch here.

twin_haunt_lamp_stew.name: Twin-Haunt Lamp-Stew

winged_twin_hunters_pot.name: Winged-Twin Hunter's Pot
winged_twin_hunters_pot.flavor: Thin, clean, almost unweighted; the plate finishes you before you finish it.

twin_imp_infernal_hash.name: Twin-Imp Infernal Hash
twin_imp_infernal_hash.flavor: Horn-ash and claw render into a surprisingly honest broth; the fire in the chest is subtle.

twin_scribbler_clarity_pot.name: Twin-Scribbler Clarity Pot

drake_flame_twin_ember_pot.name: Drake-Flame Twin-Ember Pot

serpent_and_hood_grit_stew.name: Serpent-and-Hood Grit Stew
serpent_and_hood_grit_stew.flavor: Twice-boiled coil; venom becomes a dull edge inside the ribs.

f21_behir_bogmire.name: Behir Thunder-Fillet with Lightning Moss
f21_behir_bogmire.flavor: The storm-serpent flesh still hums where the swamp moss steeps it blue.

f21_sea_dragon_mariner.name: Sea-Spawn Scale Chowder

f21_fungal_poison.name: Fungal-Horror Spore Pot
f21_fungal_poison.flavor: Pot-steamed with a plain cap, the horror bloom goes down thick and bitter-sweet.

f21_echidna_mother.name: Echidna Mother-Flesh Roast
f21_echidna_mother.flavor: A roast older than the Olympians, served rare with moss for a plate.

f21_skeleton_necromancer_barrow.name: Necromancer-Marrow Barrow Soup
f21_skeleton_necromancer_barrow.flavor: The marrow still tastes of chalk and candle; smoke the pot with incense until it quiets.

f21_skeleton_champion_haunt.name: Champion-Bone Nightwatch Broth
f21_skeleton_champion_haunt.flavor: The warrior marrow refuses the pot heat; set a candle beside it and sip at the vigil hour.

f21_dire_wolf_alpha_wild.name: Alpha-Flank with Hunter Moss
f21_dire_wolf_alpha_wild.flavor: The pack-leader flank yields a cut the color of iron; eat it standing, by the fire.

f21_cave_troll_hearth.name: Troll-Haunch Hearth Pot
f21_cave_troll_hearth.flavor: Even dead, the troll thigh knits itself around the mushroom cap as it stews.

f21_demonic_imp_warmth.name: Imp-Ichor Ember Stew
f21_demonic_imp_warmth.flavor: A ladle of imp-ichor keeps the pot bubbling long after the fire goes dark.

f21_kobold_dragonshield_sunwarm.name: Dragonshield Kobold Hearthcake
f21_kobold_dragonshield_sunwarm.flavor: The little dragon-cousin crisps on the hot stones like a sun-bleached scale.

f21_snake_charmer_wyrmling.name: Charmer Twice-Bitten Soup
f21_snake_charmer_wyrmling.flavor: Two bites, charmer and cap, each bitter, then the warmth that follows.

f21_void_elemental_shadow.name: Voidspun Shadow Consomme
f21_void_elemental_shadow.flavor: Clear as a well, dark as the back of an eyelid; stare into the bowl and see further.

f21_gnoll_fang_vigor.name: Yeenoghu Fang-Marrow Pot
f21_gnoll_fang_vigor.flavor: The gnoll chieftain flesh still smells of carrion; the moss hides it, barely.

f21_orc_marauder_wild.name: Marauder Blood Pudding
f21_orc_marauder_wild.flavor: The raider heart cooked in its own blood, smoked under incense, eaten standing.

f21_nalfeshnee_cunning.name: Nalfeshnee Thought-Marrow Jelly
f21_nalfeshnee_cunning.flavor: The demon ichor sets around a shard of crystal into a mind-clear jelly.

f21_erlking_shadow.name: Erlking Twilight Mote-Cake
f21_erlking_shadow.flavor: Dropped into holy water, the fey mote dissolves to a dusk-colored broth.

f21_troll_brute_hearth.name: Troll-Brute Mending Pot
f21_troll_brute_hearth.flavor: The thigh regrows in the pot faster than the moss can soften.

f21_elder_basilisk_mire.name: Basilisk-Eye Stewed with Mire-Moss
f21_elder_basilisk_mire.flavor: Keep the eye closed in the pot or the cook turns to stone; stir blind.

f21_corrosive_ooze_bogmire.name: Corrosive Ooze Souring Pot
f21_corrosive_ooze_bogmire.flavor: Salt cuts the acid; what remains in the pot is sour, bright, and alive.

f21_goblin_warpriest_pilgrim.name: Warpriest Hymn-Marrow Soup
f21_goblin_warpriest_pilgrim.flavor: The goblin holy-greed is washed out in a bowl of blessed water.

f21_harrow_witch_haunt.name: Harrow-Witch Thorn Tea
f21_harrow_witch_haunt.flavor: The witch heart simmered under candle-smoke; drink while the smoke is thick.

f21_moss_sentinel_mossgrown.name: Moss-Sentinel Woodheart Soup
f21_moss_sentinel_mossgrown.flavor: The construct heart is already half-moss; the pot finishes the greening.

f21_greater_earth_elemental_cold.name: Stone-Heart Highland Chowder
f21_greater_earth_elemental_cold.flavor: The earth-giant heart is salted and simmered until it tastes of winter stone.

f21_sable_serpent_wyrmling.name: Sable-Serpent Dusk Pot
f21_sable_serpent_wyrmling.flavor: The dark snake flesh is sweeter than its name; the moss keeps the poison in check.

f21_deep_iron_quickstep.name: Deep-Iron Trailcake
f21_deep_iron_quickstep.flavor: A shaving of deep-iron folded into mushroom paste, chews heavy, runs light.

f21_tri_necromancer_scribe.name: Necromancer Final Lectern Stew
f21_tri_necromancer_scribe.flavor: A dead scholar marrow, incense, and a plain cap; the recipe reads itself aloud as it cooks.

f21_tri_erlking_crone.name: Erlking Mote-Thought Reduction
f21_tri_erlking_crone.flavor: A single mote stirred into incense-steeped water; the pot begins to whisper back.

f21_tri_void_voidsong.name: Void-Essence Shadow Trio
f21_tri_void_voidsong.flavor: Three dark things married in the pot: one looks, one listens, one hums.

f21_tri_harrow_witch_crone.name: Harrow-Witch Thrice-Lit Pot
f21_tri_harrow_witch_crone.flavor: The witch heart simmers between smoke and cap; the pot picks its own stirrer.

f21_tri_dire_wolf_sinew.name: Alpha Three-Hunger Ragout
f21_tri_dire_wolf_sinew.flavor: The pack-leader muscle, slow-rendered with moss and cap, pulls like braided rope.

f21_tri_basilisk_sentinel.name: Basilisk-Eye Three-Stone Pot
f21_tri_basilisk_sentinel.flavor: Shard, salt, and a lidded eye; stand still over the fire so the pot stands still with you.

f21_tri_troll_brute_grove.name: Troll-Brute Deep-Grove Pot
f21_tri_troll_brute_grove.flavor: The brute thigh regrows twice before the moss and cap are done softening.

f21_tri_moss_sentinel_warden.name: Moss-Sentinel Thrice-Grown Soup
f21_tri_moss_sentinel_warden.flavor: The construct heart, the moss that fed it, and the incense that woke it; one bowl, three vigils.

f21_tri_deep_iron_bulwark.name: Deep-Iron Standing-Stone Stew
f21_tri_deep_iron_bulwark.flavor: A shaving of deep-iron, a shard, and a palm of brine; the pot stands where you set it.

f21_tri_sable_marshlight.name: Sable-Serpent Marshlight Pot
f21_tri_sable_marshlight.flavor: The dark serpent flesh glows faintly green through moss and mushroom-cap by the second hour.

f21_tri_demonic_imp_cinder.name: Imp-Ichor Thrice-Scorched Pot
f21_tri_demonic_imp_cinder.flavor: Three ember-colored things in one pot; the lid lifts itself twice before you serve.

f21_tri_corrosive_wyrmblood.name: Corrosive-Ooze Souring Trio
f21_tri_corrosive_wyrmblood.flavor: Shard and salt cut the acid; what remains is strong and keeps the drinker blood its own.

f21_tri_nalfeshnee_oracle.name: Nalfeshnee Thought-Marrow Trine
f21_tri_nalfeshnee_oracle.flavor: Demon-marrow bound by crystal and holy water; the pot begins to answer in words.

f21_tri_greater_earth_titan.name: Greater-Earth Three-Stone Pot
f21_tri_greater_earth_titan.flavor: A spoon of elemental heart, a shard, and brine; the pot sets like a monument.

f21_tri_fungal_horror_balewright.name: Fungal-Horror Thrice-Bloom Pot
f21_tri_fungal_horror_balewright.flavor: Three fungal things fight for the top of the pot; the drinker wins the war.

combo_frost_crawler_abyssal_kelp.name: Rime-Crawler and Abyssal Kelp Chowder
combo_frost_crawler_abyssal_kelp.flavor: The crawler's rimed shell shears into the kelp; the pot steams blue and refuses to warm the room.

combo_red_dragon_incense_roast.name: Dragon-Furnace Incense Roast
combo_red_dragon_incense_roast.flavor: The scale blackens around the burning incense; the kitchen smells like a shrine on a hot afternoon.

combo_medusa_holy_consomme.name: Gorgon's Clarifying Broth
combo_medusa_holy_consomme.flavor: The marbled meat loosens its serpent-musk into the clean water; the broth comes clear enough to read by.

combo_minotaur_salt_pot.name: Minotaur-Shoulder Salt Pot
combo_minotaur_salt_pot.flavor: A deep red shoulder, salted hard; the fat renders slow and the room gets quieter around the stove.

combo_storm_giant_deep_iron.name: Storm-Giant Deep-Iron Braise
combo_storm_giant_deep_iron.flavor: Iron shavings sink into the braising cut; by the end the pot feels heavier than four hands should lift.

combo_vampire_iron_marrow.name: Vampire-Marrow Iron Pot
combo_vampire_iron_marrow.flavor: The marrow runs black against the iron and sets dark; the smell is cold cellar and old coin.

combo_vampire_spawn_holy_consomme.name: Spawn-Marrow and Holy Water Consomme
combo_vampire_spawn_holy_consomme.flavor: The marrow shivers in the clean water and the surface takes a mirror-sheen the cook keeps staring into.

combo_apprentice_lich_crystal.name: Apprentice-Lich Crystal Draught
combo_apprentice_lich_crystal.flavor: The shard dissolves in a thin, bright steam that the dry old marrow drinks all the way down.

combo_demi_lich_incense_broth.name: Demi-Lich Incense Ritual Broth
combo_demi_lich_incense_broth.flavor: The incense curls thin and does not rise; it lies on the broth like a second lid and refuses to lift.

combo_death_knight_pilgrim_stew.name: Fallen-Knight's Pilgrim Stew
combo_death_knight_pilgrim_stew.flavor: The sanctified water hisses as it hits the dark cut; what comes up is grave-silence seasoned with grace.

combo_greater_demon_incense.name: Daemon-Ichor Incense Pot
combo_greater_demon_incense.flavor: The ichor drinks the incense entirely; what is left in the pot does not smell like anything, and that is the point.

combo_marilith_moss_pot.name: Marilith-Spawn Moss Pot
combo_marilith_moss_pot.flavor: Six-armed cuts coiled into the green; the moss leeches the venom out and keeps it, sullenly, in itself.

combo_glabrezu_salt_platter.name: Glabrezu-Pincer Salted Platter
combo_glabrezu_salt_platter.flavor: The pincer salts dry overnight; a thin keen edge comes up along the cut and does not go away in the pan.

combo_greater_mimic_mushroom.name: Mimic-Sac Mushroom Stew
combo_greater_mimic_mushroom.flavor: The sac empties sweet, like it wanted to be something else; the mushroom thickens the pot into a watchful dark.

combo_flayer_incense_reduction.name: Flayer-Sac Incense Reduction
combo_flayer_incense_reduction.flavor: The incense burns thin and purple over the sac; the kitchen seems full of other people for an hour afterward.

combo_void_crawler_crystal.name: Void-Crawler Crystal Draught
combo_void_crawler_crystal.flavor: The shard sinks and leaves a column of clear in the black broth; the eye follows it down and keeps following.

combo_nightwing_moss.name: Nightwing-Marrow Moss Pot
combo_nightwing_moss.flavor: A bitter, dark-feather tea; it keeps the lids open past the point where the body would rather be elsewhere.

tri_red_dragon_pyroclast.name: Red-Dragon Pyroclast of the Three Flames
tri_red_dragon_pyroclast.flavor: Three heats layered in one pot; the lid rides a hand's-breadth above the rim all through the simmer.

tri_rime_walker_chowder.name: Rime-Walker's Three-Chamber Chowder
tri_rime_walker_chowder.flavor: A chowder so cold it fogs the room; the spoon comes out beaded with frost and the beads do not fall.

tri_thunderwyrm_trinity.name: Thunderwyrm Trinity Platter
tri_thunderwyrm_trinity.flavor: The iron shavings jump a hair's-breadth whenever the pot bubbles; the whole kitchen tastes like a struck anvil.

tri_daemon_marilith_reduction.name: Daemon-Marilith Three-Flesh Reduction
tri_daemon_marilith_reduction.flavor: Salted hard, cooked low; the pot gives off a bright, dry heat that burns the throat clean on the way down.

tri_vampire_knight_ancestral.name: Vampire-Knight Ancestral Three
tri_vampire_knight_ancestral.flavor: Two old marrows and one small censer; the broth comes out so dark the spoon reflects in it.

tri_deathless_lich_trinity.name: Deathless-Lich Scholar Trinity
tri_deathless_lich_trinity.flavor: The shard dissolves between the two marrows; what comes up is a thin clean light the cook has to look away from.

tri_giant_troll_braise.name: Giant-and-Troll Three-Hearth Braise
tri_giant_troll_braise.flavor: Three heavy cuts in one iron pot; the pot leaves a dark ring on the stone when it finally comes off.

tri_thrice_hewn_golem.name: Thrice-Hewn Golem Keep-Stew
tri_thrice_hewn_golem.flavor: Three hard things set into a long slow pot; by the fourth hour the stew tastes like the floor you stand on.

tri_gorgon_three_chalice.name: Gorgon-Three Clarifying Chalice
tri_gorgon_three_chalice.flavor: Three serpent-scents in clean water; the broth clears impossibly and the bottom of the chalice becomes visible.

tri_phase_manticore_hunter.name: Phase-and-Manticore Three-Hunter's Pot
tri_phase_manticore_hunter.flavor: The matriarch's cut keeps shifting under the spoon; the moss holds it in place long enough to be eaten.

tri_chimera_roc_warspeaker.name: Chimera-Roc Warspeaker Three
tri_chimera_roc_warspeaker.flavor: Three heads of meat, one great wing, and a shrine's worth of smoke; the pot takes on a voice late in the simmer.

tri_elder_werewolf_cerberus.name: Elder-Werewolf and Three-Headed Trinity
tri_elder_werewolf_cerberus.flavor: Four jaws' worth of meat in one green pot; the whole stew keeps moving even when the fire is down.

tri_twin_colossus_marrow.name: Twin-Colossus Three-Marrow Pot
tri_twin_colossus_marrow.flavor: Two colossal marrows and a fistful of salt; the pot sits on the fire like it was always a wall.

tri_gelatinous_void_mirror.name: Gelatinous-Titan Mirror-Three Broth
tri_gelatinous_void_mirror.flavor: The surface will not hold its shape; the ladle finds the bowl in a different place every time.

tri_abyssal_balor_feast.name: Abyssal-Champion Three-Daemon Feast
tri_abyssal_balor_feast.flavor: Three dark cuts and a plume of incense that will not thin; the throat finds a song in it before the first bite.

quartet_four_flame_daemon.name: The Four-Flame Daemon Pyre
quartet_four_flame_daemon.flavor: Four heats stacked under one lid; the kitchen stone darkens by a shade and holds that shade for a week.

quartet_four_shrouds.name: The Four Shrouds of the Deathless Court
quartet_four_shrouds.flavor: Four old marrows asked the same question of one pot; the pot answered in a voice the cook refuses to repeat.

quartet_giant_kings_mountains.name: The Giant-Kings' Quartet of Mountains
quartet_giant_kings_mountains.flavor: Four hearth-sized cuts in one great pot; the stones under the hearth settle a half-inch deeper by sunrise.

quartet_alchemists_fangs.name: The Alchemist's Quartet of Fangs
quartet_alchemists_fangs.flavor: Four serpent-things in one chalice; by the end the broth is naming objects on the counter under its breath.

quartet_prismatic_thrones.name: The Prismatic Feast of the Four Thrones
quartet_prismatic_thrones.flavor: Four high-marrow cuts in one impossible pot; the steam comes up in bands of color that do not match the room.

f41_wyrm_shard_fillet.name: Wyrm-Scale Fillet in Shardlight
f41_wyrm_shard_fillet.flavor: The scale catches the shard-light and throws it back in a dozen cold angles.

f41_demon_knight_sacrament.name: Demon Knight's Blessed Sacrament
f41_demon_knight_sacrament.flavor: Ichor and chrism in the same pan; the smell is wrong and the taste is strangely bracing.

f41_marshal_iron_steak.name: Hobgoblin Marshal's Iron-Seared Steak
f41_marshal_iron_steak.flavor: Shavings of deep iron rest on the sear until the meat sings with discipline.

f41_imp_lord_ember_pan.name: Imp-Lord Ember Pan
f41_imp_lord_ember_pan.flavor: Two burning cuts, one patient pan; the lid rattles the way a kettle refuses to settle.

f42_young_dragon_saltscale.name: Young Dragon Saltscale
f42_young_dragon_saltscale.flavor: The salt draws the ice-blood out until the heartscale rings like a bell under a knife.

f42_vampire_lord_vigil.name: Vampire Lord's Incense Vigil
f42_vampire_lord_vigil.flavor: Marrow softens in the censer's smoke; the dish does its best thinking after midnight.

f42_lich_ironpress.name: Lich-Marrow Pressed on Deep Iron
f42_lich_ironpress.flavor: A slow press that drives the cold out and leaves something that will not move for anyone.

f42_sphinx_kelp_tartare.name: Sphinx and Abyssal-Kelp Tartare
f42_sphinx_kelp_tartare.flavor: Riddle-meat laid under a bruise-dark leaf; the dish watches you back from the plate.

f42_plague_witch_mossbed.name: Plague-Witch Pottage on a Mossbed
f42_plague_witch_mossbed.flavor: The moss catches whatever rose off the witch; the broth beneath is sweeter than it has any right to be.

f42_vine_horror_mushroom_pie.name: Vine-Horror and Cave-Mushroom Pie
f42_vine_horror_mushroom_pie.flavor: Heartwood layered with cap-wedges; steam curls out of the crust in slow fog-ribbons.

f44_elder_mind_flayer_shardlamp.name: Elder Flayer-Sac Under Shardlamp
f44_elder_mind_flayer_shardlamp.flavor: The sac shines through the shard until the whole dish throws unexpected shadows.

f44_yeenoghu_twinhowl_pot.name: Twin-Howl Yeenoghu Pot
f44_yeenoghu_twinhowl_pot.flavor: Two choppings into one pot; the pack and the pit remember each other in the broth.

f45_lurking_horror_sanctus.name: Lurking Horror Sanctus
f45_lurking_horror_sanctus.flavor: Watercourse and watcher-sac meet in a clear reduction that stares back without blinking.

f45_ettin_twinhead_pie.name: Ettin Warchief Twin-Head Pie
f45_ettin_twinhead_pie.flavor: Two cuts, one crust; the mushrooms argue with the meat until the pie settles its own quarrel.

f46_hierophant_censer_porridge.name: Hierophant's Censer Porridge
f46_hierophant_censer_porridge.flavor: The censer smokes over the pot until the porridge pulls hymn-smell up out of itself.

f47_void_leviathan_rangda_triad.name: Leviathan, Rangda, and Deep-Iron Triad
f47_void_leviathan_rangda_triad.flavor: A dish of two long shadows and a sliver of hammered iron; it moves faster off the plate than you expect.

f48_throne_sentinel_golem_shardstew.name: Throne-Sentinel and Stone-Golem Shardstew
f48_throne_sentinel_golem_shardstew.flavor: Two kinds of standing-weight simmered until the shards sing a low keep-your-ground note.

f49_war_troll_three_trolls.name: The Three-Troll Warchant
f49_war_troll_three_trolls.flavor: Three cuts off three trolls bellow into the broth and then settle, patient, under a lid.

f49_elder_vampire_marrow_choir.name: Elder-Vampire Marrow Choir
f49_elder_vampire_marrow_choir.flavor: Two marrows and the censer-smoke keep a slow prayer going above the pot.

f49_abyssal_hound_demonic_trinity.name: Abyssal-Hound Infernal Trinity
f49_abyssal_hound_demonic_trinity.flavor: Three hot cuts rendered patient; the pot throws no sparks because the fat holds the fire inside.

f49_corrupted_treant_mossgrove.name: Corrupted-Treant Mossgrove Pot
f49_corrupted_treant_mossgrove.flavor: Two heart-wounds and a bed of moss weep green together until the pot forgets what hurt it.

f49_skeleton_horde_bone_requiem.name: Three-Bone Requiem
f49_skeleton_horde_bone_requiem.flavor: Marrow drawn from three different silences; the broth clears to a pale, patient grey.

f50_elder_beholder_eye_vigil.name: Elder-Beholder Eye Vigil
f50_elder_beholder_eye_vigil.flavor: Two unsettling eye-cuts rinsed in blessed water; the dish is quietly, insistently awake.

f46_hierophant_witch_censer_rite.name: Hierophant and Plague-Witch Censer Rite
f46_hierophant_witch_censer_rite.flavor: Hymn-smell and rot-smell meet in the smoke and leave a bright, startling note in the broth.

f42_sphinx_dragon_crystal_trine.name: Sphinx, Young-Dragon, and Crystal Trine
f42_sphinx_dragon_crystal_trine.flavor: A riddle-cut, a heartscale, and a storm-coloured shard put the pot into a steady electric hum.

f49_war_quartet_of_shoulders.name: The War Quartet of Four Shoulders
f49_war_quartet_of_shoulders.flavor: Four shoulders laid in one trench of a pan; the kitchen smells like a muster going downhill.

f49_bone_pact_of_four.name: Bone-Pact of the Four Marrows
f49_bone_pact_of_four.flavor: Four marrows rendered side by side; the pot keeps a slow count no one taught it.

f49_abyssal_warhorn_quartet.name: Abyssal Warhorn Quartet
f49_abyssal_warhorn_quartet.flavor: Four infernal cuts; the pan sings a slow brass note under the lid.

f50_watchers_quartet.name: The Watchers' Quartet
f50_watchers_quartet.flavor: Four cuts that would rather not meet; sealed under a lid they finally agree on something.

f49_prism_feast_of_four.name: The Prism Feast of Four Elder Beasts
f49_prism_feast_of_four.flavor: Scale, scale, riddle, and heartwood layered like coloured glass; the pot throws rainbows when you lift the lid.

r_f5160_dragon_prism_pot.name: Elder-Wyrm Prism Pot
r_f5160_dragon_prism_pot.flavor: The old scale catches lamplight through the shard and sends it back doubled.

r_f5160_fireking_hallowed_coals.name: Fire-King's Hallowed Coals
r_f5160_fireking_hallowed_coals.flavor: Giant-fat sears over hearth-stones while a blessed trickle keeps the smoke sweet.

r_f5160_jarlfrost_rime_trencher.name: Jarl-Frost Rime Trencher
r_f5160_jarlfrost_rime_trencher.flavor: A slab of jarl-shoulder packed in sea-kelp and ice until it rings like a bell.

r_f5160_dreadsphinx_enigma_tea.name: Dread-Sphinx Enigma Tea
r_f5160_dreadsphinx_enigma_tea.flavor: Steam curls into shapes you almost recognize, and the riddle unknots in the drinking.

r_f5160_nemean_redspit.name: Nemean Lion Red-Iron Haunch
r_f5160_nemean_redspit.flavor: The impervious hide softens only in the glow of an iron spit, and the meat tastes of victory.

r_f5160_babayaga_fogveil_soup.name: Baba-Yaga Fogveil Soup
r_f5160_babayaga_fogveil_soup.flavor: Marsh-moss and old-woman marrow brew a thin broth that teaches the eye to see sideways.

r_f5160_deathlord_hallowed_marrow.name: Death-Lord Hallowed Marrow
r_f5160_deathlord_hallowed_marrow.flavor: The marrow weeps black at first, but holy water settles it into a mournful amber.

r_f5160_kingslayer_salt_rub.name: Kingslayer Hunter's Salt-Rub
r_f5160_kingslayer_salt_rub.flavor: A coarse salt crust seals in the goblin-champion's unlikely strength.

r_f5160_irongolem_mountain_pot.name: Iron-Golem Mountain Pot
r_f5160_irongolem_mountain_pot.flavor: You render the construct's lubricant marrow with its own ore until the pot refuses to tip.

r_f5160_trickster_hood_broth.name: Trickster-Smoke Hood-Broth
r_f5160_trickster_hood_broth.flavor: Incense keeps the imp quiet in the pot; the broth stains your tongue the color of dusk.

r_f5160_wyrmblood_terrine.name: Wyrmblood Scalding Terrine
r_f5160_wyrmblood_terrine.flavor: Two wyrm-cuts layered against a shard that keeps the blood from boiling away its memory.

r_f5160_abyss_balewright_stew.name: Abyss-Overlord Balewright Stew
r_f5160_abyss_balewright_stew.flavor: Two throne-devils simmered under incense until the pit-stink mellows into something almost warm.

r_f5160_dragon_warspeaker_hoard.name: Dragon-Line Warspeaker Hoard
r_f5160_dragon_warspeaker_hoard.flavor: Elder and whelp cuts stacked over an iron brazier; the roar you taste is the lineage, not the meat.

r_f5160_jarl_troll_rime_pot.name: Jarl-and-Troll Rime Pot
r_f5160_jarl_troll_rime_pot.flavor: A sea-kelp wrap holds the two cold-bloods together through a slow, patient freeze.

r_f5160_three_crones_pot.name: Three Crones' Pot
r_f5160_three_crones_pot.flavor: An old wives' broth that whispers back when stirred counter-clockwise.

r_f5160_two_sphinx_vigil.name: Two-Sphinx Vigil Broth
r_f5160_two_sphinx_vigil.flavor: Both sphinxes stay silent for once, and the pot sees everything they will not say.

r_f5160_mindflayer_insight_terrine.name: Mind-Flayer Insight Terrine
r_f5160_mindflayer_insight_terrine.flavor: A terrible terrine of eye, tentacle, and lion-heart; the plate thinks faster than you do.

r_f5160_twin_sentry_iron_pot.name: Twin-Sentry Iron Pot
r_f5160_twin_sentry_iron_pot.flavor: Two watchmen rendered down into one patient pot that stands its own guard overnight.

r_f5160_three_captain_fiend_stew.name: Three-Captain Fiend Stew
r_f5160_three_captain_fiend_stew.flavor: Rank over rank in the kettle, each devil shouting the next into tenderness.

r_f5160_three_knight_grave_pot.name: Three-Knight Grave Pot
r_f5160_three_knight_grave_pot.flavor: Three undying captains layered in a single pot; the lid rattles like a muster-call.

r_f5160_three_dragon_element_crown.name: Three-Dragon Element Crown
r_f5160_three_dragon_element_crown.flavor: Three generations of dragon-cuts around a prismed shard; every color of the hoard answers at once.

r_f5160_two_giants_fafnir_hoard.name: The Giants' Fafnir-Hoard Feast
r_f5160_two_giants_fafnir_hoard.flavor: Two giant-kings share a plate with Fafnir's own hoard-meat; your shoulders remember being that wide.

r_f5160_thrice_wise_crone_pot.name: The Thrice-Wise Crone-Pot
r_f5160_thrice_wise_crone_pot.flavor: Three mouths that have outlived everything, muttering into one pot of smoking myrrh.

r_f5160_four_iron_bastion.name: Four-Iron Bastion Feast
r_f5160_four_iron_bastion.flavor: Four constructs rendered to a single oil, and the ribs set like a shield wall overnight.

r_f5160_hierarchy_of_hells_four_pot.name: Hierarchy-of-Hells Four-Pot
r_f5160_hierarchy_of_hells_four_pot.flavor: Priest, trickster, and devil share a kettle; the blessed water keeps them from arguing.

r_f5160_sunforge_cauldron.name: The Sun-Forge Cauldron of First-Age Flame
r_f5160_sunforge_cauldron.flavor: Four burning kings and the ore of the mountain-root; the pot hums the same note the sun hums.

r_f5160_nine_night_feast_crones.name: The Nine-Night Feast of the Dead Crone-Kings
r_f5160_nine_night_feast_crones.flavor: Four old throats and nine nights of myrrh-smoke; the dungeon pauses and sets a chair for you.

r_f6170_frostfang_rimeheart_pot.name: Frostfang-and-Rimeheart Pot
r_f6170_frostfang_rimeheart_pot.flavor: The giant's marrow freezes against the elemental's core; the pot rings like struck glass.

r_f6170_twin_primordial_hearth.name: Twin-Primordial Hearthbroil
r_f6170_twin_primordial_hearth.flavor: Two living flames settle in the pot and keep arguing after the lid goes on.

r_f6170_titan_storm_mountainloaf.name: Titan-and-Storm-Giant Mountainloaf
r_f6170_titan_storm_mountainloaf.flavor: A loaf that sits in the gut the way a mountain sits in its range.

r_f6170_twin_lich_dracolich_reduction.name: Twin-Lich and Dracolich Reduction
r_f6170_twin_lich_dracolich_reduction.flavor: Two old minds boil down to a single clear broth; the steam reads to you.

r_f6170_hydra_serpent_blood_pot.name: Hydra-and-Serpent Blood Pot
r_f6170_hydra_serpent_blood_pot.flavor: Two kinds of scale coil in the pot; the ladle comes up warm with other appetites.

r_f6170_twin_shadow_fogveil.name: Twin-Shadow Fogveil Stew
r_f6170_twin_shadow_fogveil.flavor: The pot refuses to settle on one color; the broth looks away when you look at it.

r_f6170_vampire_crypt_wyrmling.name: Vampire-Lord and Crypt-Summoner Broth
r_f6170_vampire_crypt_wyrmling.flavor: A dark broth laid down with the quiet patience of tombs; it holds.

r_f6170_jackal_assassin_fleet.name: Jackal-and-Assassin Fleet-Pot
r_f6170_jackal_assassin_fleet.flavor: Two quick cuts, two quick cooks; the wrist remembers everything the pot does.

r_f6170_demon_imperial_rally.name: Demon-General's Imperial Rally-Pot
r_f6170_demon_imperial_rally.flavor: Two infernal cuts stacked rank-on-rank; the broth sings a marching song.

r_f6170_behemoth_inquisitor_hunter.name: Behemoth-and-Inquisitor Hunter's Pot
r_f6170_behemoth_inquisitor_hunter.flavor: A broth that looks for things on your behalf; the ladle insists on turning left.

r_f6170_infernal_court_triple_flame.name: Infernal Court Triple-Flame
r_f6170_infernal_court_triple_flame.flavor: Three red roars braided into a single steady fire; the pot stops needing a flame.

r_f6170_rimewalker_frost_trio.name: Rimewalker's Frost-North Trio
r_f6170_rimewalker_frost_trio.flavor: Three winters laid in the pot; your breath stops showing before the broth is poured.

r_f6170_three_titan_grand_spine.name: Three-Titan Grand Spine
r_f6170_three_titan_grand_spine.flavor: A spine of three enormous shoulders; the stew leans back when it is stirred.

r_f6170_thrice_lich_wyrmblood.name: Thrice-Lich Wyrmblood Reduction
r_f6170_thrice_lich_wyrmblood.flavor: Three old deaths in one pot; the vapor refuses to leave warm skin.

r_f6170_vampire_legion_balmroot.name: Vampire-Legion Dark-Balmroot Pot
r_f6170_vampire_legion_balmroot.flavor: Three graveyard cuts cooked slow; wounds close while you watch the pot.

r_f6170_thrice_shadow_jackal.name: Thrice-Shadow Jackal-Pot
r_f6170_thrice_shadow_jackal.flavor: Three dark cuts whispered into one broth; the steam picks the room's quietest corner.

r_f6170_serpent_hydra_ooze_trine.name: Serpent-Hydra-Ooze Fang-Trine
r_f6170_serpent_hydra_ooze_trine.flavor: Three venoms argue themselves into neutrality; the pot swallows poisons for you.

r_f6170_warspeaker_three_hosts.name: Warspeaker's Trio of the Three Hosts
r_f6170_warspeaker_three_hosts.flavor: Three commanders in one pot; the broth gives orders the arm obeys.

r_f6170_fallen_choir_mirror_pot.name: Fallen-Choir Mirror-Pot
r_f6170_fallen_choir_mirror_pot.flavor: A hymn goes in and a second hymn comes out behind it; the ladle sees twice.

r_f6170_three_primordial_prism.name: Three-Primordial Prism Stew
r_f6170_three_primordial_prism.flavor: Fire and ice and frost-marrow fold into one bright, cold-hot shimmer.

r_f6170_four_pillar_titan_feast.name: Four-Pillar Titan Feast
r_f6170_four_pillar_titan_feast.flavor: Four giants laid out shoulder-to-shoulder in a single long pot; the shoulders stay.

r_f6170_dark_council_fourfold.name: Dark-Council Fourfold Terrine
r_f6170_dark_council_fourfold.flavor: Four quiet thrones of the undead court; the broth reads the labels off every jar in the pantry.

r_f6170_infernal_burning_thrones_quartet.name: Quartet of the Burning Thrones
r_f6170_infernal_burning_thrones_quartet.flavor: Four fire-crowned lords stacked in a single pot; the lid rattles like a war-drum.

r_f6170_veiled_court_hawkeye_fourfold.name: Veiled-Court Hawkeye Fourfold
r_f6170_veiled_court_hawkeye_fourfold.flavor: Four watchful cuts under one lid; the broth looks over the rim like it's counting corridors.

r_f6170_primordial_elementcrown.name: Four-Chamber Primordial Elementcrown
r_f6170_primordial_elementcrown.flavor: Four elementals of four different shocks sit around a shared center; the pot wears a crown.

r_f6170_mythic_demons_pact_burning_thron.name: The Burning-Thrones Compact: Demon-King's Last Pact
r_f6170_mythic_demons_pact_burning_thron.flavor: A five-chamber infernal pact simmered in its own oath; the signature happens as you lift the ladle.

r_f6170_mythic_blood_moon_five_undying.name: Blood-Moon Rite of the Five Un-Dying
r_f6170_mythic_blood_moon_five_undying.flavor: Five deaths that refused the end are stirred together under a red lid; the broth answers back when poured.

combo_fenrir_wolf_deep_iron_recipe.name: Fenrir-Fang and Deep-Iron Pot
combo_fenrir_wolf_deep_iron_recipe.flavor: The dark meat drinks the iron shavings; the pot rings like a tuning fork when it is done.

combo_world_serpent_abyssal_kelp_recipe.name: World-Serpent and Abyssal-Kelp Chowder
combo_world_serpent_abyssal_kelp_recipe.flavor: The kelp wraps the pale serpent-fat into cords; the broth tastes of a sea too deep to see into.

combo_blood_archon_holy_water_recipe.name: Blood-Archon Rib in Holy-Water Reduction
combo_blood_archon_holy_water_recipe.flavor: The dark rib hisses as the clean water hits it; the steam smells like a chapel after a fight.

combo_soul_eater_crystal_shard_recipe.name: Soul-Eater Marrow with Crystal Shard
combo_soul_eater_crystal_shard_recipe.flavor: The marrow goes glass-clear around the shard; what you see through it is sharper than the knife.

combo_ancient_dragon_river_salt_recipe.name: Ancient-Dragon Haunch in River-Salt Crust
combo_ancient_dragon_river_salt_recipe.flavor: The salt crust turns to black glass over the slow dragon-fat; you crack it with a spoon.

tri_charybdis_ice_elemental_kelp_recipe.name: The Rimewalker's Three-Deep Ragout
tri_charybdis_ice_elemental_kelp_recipe.flavor: Three gifts of the cold water, braised until the pot steams in a slow blue plume.

tri_ravanas_arm_fire_elemental_incense_r.name: Ravana's Everburning Three-Arm Pyre
tri_ravanas_arm_fire_elemental_incense_r.flavor: The ten-headed king's spare arm sears over the elemental's own ember; the incense refuses to go out.

tri_hrungnirs_ghost_titan_iron_recipe.name: Hrungnir-Ghost Titan-Whelp Terrine
tri_hrungnirs_ghost_titan_iron_recipe.flavor: The stone-giant's ghost and the titan's flesh set hard in the mould; the iron keeps them from drifting apart.

tri_astral_horror_storm_giant_crystal_re.name: Astral-Horror Stormborn Three-Course
tri_astral_horror_storm_giant_crystal_re.flavor: The horror's pale sinew hums against the giant's rib; the shard rolls and glows along the pan with each thunder-note.

tri_entropy_wraith_plague_ooze_moss_reci.name: The Balewright's Three-Rot Potage
tri_entropy_wraith_plague_ooze_moss_reci.flavor: The pot keeps its own counsel; the moss floats, settles, and stops the broth from eating its own bowl.

quartet_green_knight_abyssal_mimic_chaos.name: The Alchemist's Prism Quartet
quartet_green_knight_abyssal_mimic_chaos.flavor: Each cut throws its own color onto the ceiling; the shard divides them like a chapel-window.

quartet_hrungnirs_ghost_titan_behemoth_i.name: Colossus-Marrow Quartet of Elder Bone
quartet_hrungnirs_ghost_titan_behemoth_i.flavor: Three bones the size of doorposts render into one gravy; the iron keeps the pot from sagging.

quartet_death_lord_lich_sovereign_banshe.name: The Lich-Court's Fourfold Arcanum
quartet_death_lord_lich_sovereign_banshe.flavor: Three kings of the dust, deboned and stewed in a water that will not stay dark; what rises is cool and very clear.

mythic_ancient_dragon_ravanas_arm_fire_e.name: Phoenix-Mantle Feast of the Nine Flames
mythic_ancient_dragon_ravanas_arm_fire_e.flavor: Four fire-born cuts over a slow ember-bed; the incense keeps burning long after the fire has gone cold.

mythic_world_serpent_jormungandr_charybd.name: Leviathan's World-Serpent Feast of the Nine Deeps
mythic_world_serpent_jormungandr_charybd.flavor: The pot is wider than a shield; the kelp braids the four great cuts together so the broth lies perfectly still.

tri_f81_titan_trencher.name: Primordial Titan's Three-Bone Trencher
tri_f81_titan_trencher.flavor: Three bones the size of pillars, roasted whole and shared out of a shield.

tri_f81_ancient_lich_triptych.name: Ancient Lich's Marrow Triptych
tri_f81_ancient_lich_triptych.flavor: Three liches' marrow boiled on a bronze mirror until the steam shows yesterday's room.

tri_f81_dracolich_wyrm_simmer.name: Dracolich-and-Wyrm Thrice-Simmer
tri_f81_dracolich_wyrm_simmer.flavor: Three dead-dragon cuts in a tar-dark reduction; the scales dissolve, the venom does not.

tri_f81_three_light_terrine.name: Three-Mote Light Terrine
tri_f81_three_light_terrine.flavor: A radiant mote, a glittering mote, a fallen mote — pressed into one terrine that casts no shadow.

tri_f81_abyssal_everburn_ragout.name: Abyssal-Dragon Everburn Ragout
tri_f81_abyssal_everburn_ragout.flavor: Three vessels of ichor reduced over its own fire; the pot keeps a low red glow for days.

quartet_f81_chromatic_wyrm_tetrad.name: The Great Chromatic Wyrm Tetrad
quartet_f81_chromatic_wyrm_tetrad.flavor: Tiamat's tear is set at the pot's center; four wyrm-essences circle it like a rainbow on oil.

quartet_f81_four_dead_kings_marrow.name: Marrow-Feast of the Four Dead-Kings
quartet_f81_four_dead_kings_marrow.flavor: Four kings who refused to die, now ladled out on one long table; the bowl stays warm until dawn.

mythic_f81_horsemen_final_communion.name: The Horsemen's Final Communion
mythic_f81_horsemen_final_communion.flavor: Five ichors from five seals, poured in order; the broth closes over them like a sealed book.

mythic_f81_ragnarok_giant_blood_trencher.name: Ragnarok's Giant-Blood Trencher
mythic_f81_ragnarok_giant_blood_trencher.flavor: Frost-giant marrow meets ember on the colossus's rib while the Wild Hunt rides the broth above.

legendary_surtur_ragnarok_feast.name: Surtur's Ragnarok Feast
legendary_surtur_ragnarok_feast.flavor: Five last trophies of the end-days -- ember, marrow, scale, stone-heart, and herald's ichor -- set to simmer under a burning sky.

legendary_tiamat_nine_world_soup.name: Tiamat's Nine-World Yggdrasil Soup
legendary_tiamat_nine_world_soup.flavor: A soup drawn from every branch and root -- chromatic tear, void-scale, radiant mote, abyssal ichor, and angel-light -- stirred until the colors answer.

pot_twin_fire_elementals.name: Twin-Ember Elemental Fillet
pot_twin_fire_elementals.flavor: Two essences meet in the pan and the pan forgets it was ever cold; a crust of warmth sets on the plate.

pot_blue_wyrm_storm_essence.name: Thunderwyrm and Storm-Essence Platter
pot_blue_wyrm_storm_essence.flavor: The scale hisses when the essence drips over it; a dry, metallic smell rises and will not leave the tongue.

pot_cerberus_hell_bovine.name: Three-Headed Cerberus and Hell-Bovine Roast
pot_cerberus_hell_bovine.flavor: Three cuts from one jaw-work, one great red haunch beside them; the drippings fight and spit on the stones.

pot_f81_buer_plague_twinbroth.name: Buer-and-Plague Twinbroth
pot_f81_buer_plague_twinbroth.flavor: A green-black ichor-stew; the pot refuses to go rancid no matter how long it simmers.

pot_f81_wendigo_fenrir_mash.name: Wendigo-and-Fenrir Hunter's Mash
pot_f81_wendigo_fenrir_mash.flavor: Two famished predators cooked down to one patient broth; it listens as it reduces.

pot_f81_ymir_frost_chowder.name: Ymir-Marrow Frost Chowder
pot_f81_ymir_frost_chowder.flavor: Ice crystals bloom across the broth like glass flowers that will not melt.

pot_f81_surtur_lavablood_pot.name: Surtur's Ember-and-Lavablood Pot
pot_f81_surtur_lavablood_pot.flavor: The ember spits once when the lava-flesh is added; after that the pot sings.
